# Test Fixtures

This directory contains test files used by Browser tests.

## Image Files
- test-image.jpg: Small test image for profile uploads
- test-avatar.jpg: Avatar test image
- gallery1.jpg, gallery2.jpg, gallery3.jpg: Gallery test images
- test-document.pdf: Invalid file type for testing validation

## Usage
These files are used in Browser tests to simulate file uploads and test file handling functionality.

All images are small (< 10KB) placeholder images created for testing purposes only.
